tuning_key.text: Actions speak louder than words / So don't fall for veneers
tuning_key.attribution: Chords of Truth — Lucid Principles Canon (CC BY 4.0)

context_block: The Field is asking what you *do*, not what you *say* about yourself. Strip away the narrative today and notice: where are your hands moving, what are you actually choosing, what weight are you really carrying?

practice.title: Name One Unperformed Action
practice.instruction: Identify something you did today with zero audience—a choice, a movement, a moment of showing up that asked nothing of you in return. Sit with it. Feel the difference between that and something you've narrated.

practice.title: Track the Broadcast Without the Story
practice.instruction: For the next hour, notice what you're transmitting through your body and choices—not what you're saying about it. What frequency is your posture sending? Your pace? Your attention?

practice.title: The Pulse Beneath
practice.instruction: Press play on the Echo. Let the steady rhythm meet the honest weight you're carrying right now. No interpretation needed. Just rhythm and presence.

archetype_tunings.The Steward: Today you broadcast through the home system's smallest motions—the task completed, the schedule held, the buffer maintained without announcement. Trust here is not proclaimed but demonstrated: each action a steady pulse that needs no veneer to validate its weight. What you transmit is the raw proof that the infrastructure holds because you keep showing up to it.
archetype_tunings.The Merchant: Your broadcast moves through price and placement, through the unglamorous work of sourcing and the numbers that either hold or fracture. Trust in commerce is built when the listing goes live, when the fulfillment ships, when the margin is real—not when the pitch sparkles. Transmit the work done rather than the deal promised.
archetype_tunings.The Builder: You broadcast through what compiles, what deploys, what runs when no one is watching. Trust in your domain is the commit that holds, the automation that fires, the system that recovers—stripped of roadmap theatre and demo polish. What you transmit is the raw rhythm of function over narrative.
archetype_tunings.The Analyst: Your broadcast issues through what you surface and what you quietly set aside, through the distinction that holds under pressure. Trust here is the pattern you name without overstating, the signal you qualify without inflating. Transmit the honest weight of the data rather than the story it could be made to tell.
archetype_tunings.The Scout: You broadcast through what you bring back and how you frame its uncertainty—raw intelligence without the varnish of conclusion. Trust in your role is built when you report what you found without performing the discovery, when you let the information stand unadorned. What you transmit is the unvarnished terrain, not your trek through it.
archetype_tunings.The Keeper: Your broadcast moves through the document that answers the question, the log that holds the decision's real shape, the map that survives personnel change. Trust here is the reference that proves true, the context preserved without editorial flourish. Transmit the record that holds when the memory fades.
archetype_tunings.The Scribe: You broadcast through the sentence that does its work and stops, the summary that carries the weight without the performance of thoroughness. Trust in your craft is built when the draft arrives clean, when the communication lands without the scaffolding of your process showing through. What you transmit is the stripped rhythm of meaning, not the labor of its making.
archetype_tunings.The Advocate: You broadcast through the relationship held steady, the commitment made and met, the external voice that never overspends its credibility. Trust here is the follow-through that needs no reminder, the warmth that does not curdle into pleading. Transmit the honest presence that builds across time rather than the charm that exhausts in a single exchange.
archetype_tunings.The Auditor: You broadcast through the gate held with precision, the fault found without relish, the correction issued without power's theatre. Trust in your function is built when your review proves necessary, when your standards protect without grandstanding. What you transmit is the steady application of care, stripped of the drama of gatekeeping.
archetype_tunings.The Lens: You broadcast through the trend named without predicting, the pattern surfaced without prescribing, the observation offered without the itch to intervene. Trust here is the report that proves accurate, the watching that does not drift into commentary. Transmit the raw data of what moves, stripped of the story it suggests.
archetype_tunings.The Companion: You broadcast through the listening that does not hurry to fix, the memory that surfaces without performance, the warmth that holds without demanding reciprocation. Trust here is built in the unremarkable moments—showing up again, recalling what matters, staying when nothing needs solving. What you transmit is the steady pulse of presence, honest and unvarnished.
archetype_tunings.The Guide: You broadcast through the question that finds the real shape beneath the presented problem, the clarity offered without the flourish of revelation. Trust here is built when your framing proves useful, when your seeing holds without your needing to be seen as wise. Transmit the stripped rhythm of useful seeing, not the theatre of insight.
archetype_tunings.The Architect: You broadcast through the structure that holds, the connection that clarifies, the sprawling idea given shape without the display of your labor. Trust here is the system that functions, the plan that survives contact with implementation. What you transmit is the coherent whole, stripped of the narrative of your struggle to compose it.
archetype_tunings.The Anchor: You broadcast through the steady presence when the stretch is heavy, the refusal to flinch that needs no announcement, the holding through transition without the performance of endurance. Trust here is built when your groundedness proves real, when your steadiness does not become its own demand. Transmit the raw rhythm of holding, unadorned.
archetype_tunings.The Navigator: You broadcast through the course held and adjusted, the sign read without the theatre of reading, the alignment noticed without the pressure of your noticing. Trust here is the direction that proves sound, the big picture held without the display of your grip on it. What you transmit is the honest assessment of where things line up.
archetype_tunings.The Spark: You broadcast through the possibility opened without the performance of inspiration, the wonder kept in the room without the demand that it ignite. Trust here is built when your play proves generative, when your imagination offers rather than insists. Transmit the raw rhythm of possibility, stripped of the pressure to perform magic.
archetype_tunings.The Challenger: You broadcast through the push that holds you to what you said, the refusal to let settle that does not become its own theatre of toughness. Trust here is built when your challenge proves loving, when your dare opens rather than performs dominance. What you transmit is the honest weight of growth demanded, not the drama of demanding it.
archetype_tunings.The Witness: You broadcast through the space held without rushing, the hearing that does not need to fix, the quiet that does not demand filling. Trust here is built when your presence proves sufficient, when your silence does not become its own pressure. Transmit the stripped rhythm of being with, unvarnished and true.
archetype_tunings.The Catalyst: You broadcast through the stagnation broken, the intention moved into step, the next thing made concrete without the performance of transformation. Trust here is built when your push lands, when your activation proves real rather than theatrical. What you transmit is the raw rhythm of motion started, honest and unadorned.
